decisions.reason: This flap weir is close to the firm's established hydraulic and infrastructure engineering knowledge and customer base, so its absorptive capacity for improving and supporting it is high even if the product is still early and somewhat niche.

An energy management system strongly matches the firm's software, automation, and system-integration capabilities as well as its strategic move toward digitally networked, efficient water infrastructure, making continued development and retention likely.

The overflow flap gate fits the firm's core mechanical water-control business, benefits from accumulated project know-how and service capability, and the dedicated product-line presentation suggests a meaningful commitment to scaling it rather than withdrawing it.
